description: Integrate CopilotKit Deep Agents for frontend-agent communication via AG-UI protocol

userStories.title: Add CopilotKit middleware to deep agent backend
userStories.description: As a developer, I need CopilotKitMiddleware in the backend agent stack so the agent can communicate via AG-UI protocol.
acceptanceCriteria: CopilotKitMiddleware() added early in middleware stack (before PII/compaction)
Agent creates successfully with new middleware
Existing agent behavior unaffected without CopilotKit frontend
userStories.notes: See specs/001. Files: backend/pyproject.toml, backend/src/agents/__init__.py, backend/src/utils/middleware.py

userStories.title: Add CopilotKit frontend packages
userStories.description: As a developer, I need CopilotKit React packages installed so I can use hooks and components.
userStories.notes: See specs/002. Run pnpm add in frontend directory.

userStories.title: Create CopilotKit runtime API endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a backend API endpoint for CopilotKit runtime so the frontend can communicate with the agent via AG-UI protocol.
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoint uses LangGraphAgent adapter to connect to existing deep agent
Authentication consistent with existing API routes
userStories.notes: See specs/003. Orchestra is Vite+React Router, so endpoint goes in FastAPI backend, NOT Next.js App Router.

userStories.title: Wrap app with CopilotKit provider
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the app wrapped with CopilotKit provider so hooks work throughout the frontend.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify in browser using agent-browser skill
userStories.notes: See specs/004. Wrap at root layout level.

userStories.title: Add CopilotKit UI surface component
userStories.description: As a user, I want a CopilotKit chat interface so I can interact with the agent through the AG-UI protocol.
acceptanceCriteria: CopilotKit UI component (CopilotPopup recommended) rendered and accessible
Can send messages through CopilotKit interface
Agent responds correctly through AG-UI protocol
Styled to match Orchestra theme (green accent, dark/light mode)
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill
userStories.notes: See specs/005. Critical missing piece from original specs. CopilotPopup is least invasive for initial integration.

userStories.title: Integrate useDefaultTool for tool call rendering
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see tool calls rendered in the CopilotKit chat so I can understand what the agent is doing.
acceptanceCriteria: useDefaultTool hook integrated in CopilotKit UI component
Tool calls render visually as cards in CopilotKit chat
Verify in browser using agent-browser skill

userStories.title: Verify streaming compatibility and backward compatibility
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to ensure AG-UI streaming works alongside existing SSE streaming without regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: No regressions in current chat functionality
Concurrent usage of both paths works
userStories.notes: See specs/007. Both streaming paths must coexist.

userStories.title: Documentation, tests, and push all changes
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all changes documented, tested, and pushed so the PR is ready for code review.
acceptanceCriteria: API and user documentation updated in wiki repo
New tests for CopilotKit middleware and endpoint
All previous and new tests pass
No new dependencies beyond CopilotKit packages
userStories.notes: See specs/008. LAST STEP: must push all changes so they're visible for code review.
